verdict.rationale: Reducto is an API-first document platform. Its docs cover Parse, Extract, Split, Classify, Edit and async endpoints such as POST /parse_async, with Python, Node.js, Go and cURL examples, and a probe confirmed a public OpenAPI spec and llms.txt. missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of driving the API in practice, documented auth and rate-limit details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Parse is Reducto’s foundational endpoint. It converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting
Application code: use the Python, Node.js, Go, or cURL examples below.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.reducto.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
returning a unique `reducto://` identifier you can pass to any downstream endpoint: Classify, Parse, Split, Extract, or Edit.
